summary: Mode-dependent row-wise data copy on the audio playback path (called by AudioPlaybackDispatcher): when a7 == -1 it performs a straight block copy of a5 dwords per row across a6 rows, advancing source by row pitch a2 and destination by row pitch a4; otherwise it copies only dwords that differ from the mask value (a7 & 0xFFFFFF), leaving destination cells equal to the mask untouched. Also records the mode flag, mask and per-row dword count into shared globals consumed elsewhere in the audio subsystem.

operations.description: Store the full-copy mode flag: dword_5DD844 = (a7 == -1).
Store the mask value: dword_5DD804 = a7 & 0xFFFFFF.
Store the per-row dword count: dword_5DD814 = a5.
Branch on the stored mode flag: take the full block-copy path when dword_5DD844 == 1 (a7 == -1), otherwise take the masked path.
Outer do-while over a6 rows in full-copy mode, countdown counter v10 seeded from a6.
Copy 4 * v9 bytes (v9 = a5 dwords) from source a1 to destination a3 per row via qmemcpy.
Advance source by row pitch a2 and destination by row pitch a4: a1 = a1 + a2, a3 = a3 + a4.
Outer do-while over a6 rows in masked mode, countdown counter seeded from a6.
Inner do-while over a5 dwords per row, countdown counter v16 seeded from a5.
Copy the loaded dword v17 only when it differs from the stored mask v14 = dword_5DD804; dwords equal to the mask are skipped, leaving the destination cell unchanged.
Advance source by row pitch a2 and destination by row pitch a4 after each masked row (a1 += a2, a3 += a4).
Invoked by AudioPlaybackDispatcher (0x005401A0) on the audio playback path.

clean_pseudocode: void sub_560A82(char *src, int srcPitch, char *dst, int dstPitch, int dwords, int rows, int a7) {
do { qmemcpy(dst, src, 4 * dwords); src += srcPitch; dst += dstPitch; } while (--n > 0);
do { int v = *(DWORD *)src; if (v != mask) *(DWORD *)dst = v; src += 4; dst += 4; } while (--m > 0);

a7 semantics: -1 selects plain copy while other values act as a fill/mask value; the exact audio meaning depends on the AudioPlaybackDispatcher call context.
The mask branch leaves cells equal to the mask untouched, implying the destination was pre-initialized to the mask value by the caller.
